title: The Azure CLI
summary: Ten az commands, each missing the flag that makes it do the job. Run them in Cloud Shell or a terminal you're signed in to; the guided project for the CLI walks through most of them.

location.clue: A resource group in West Europe

tags.clue: A resource group tagged as a development one

output.clue: Your resource groups, as a table

query.clue: Only the names of the regions

lock-type.clue: A lock that stops the resource group being deleted

image.clue: A Linux virtual machine from a marketplace image

sku.clue: A storage account whose data is spread across availability zones

access-tier.clue: Make cool the account's default tier, for new blobs and for existing ones with no tier set

offset.clue: What happened to the resource group in the past week

yes.clue: Delete the resource group without being asked to confirm
